title: CompareTable
description: contracts/claims/compare.v1.json (D113): the landing page's comparison table, columns by rows of other kinds of tools. TrustAgent's own row is not here: it reads the value claims. A cell says what the vendor documents, never a ranking. A cell other than unverified needs the source_url its author actually fetched (public docs, read-only) and as_of, the fetch date (validate.mjs). The landing shows unverified as "Not yet verified"; check-claims --launch refuses any unverified or reviewed:false cell, and the owner reviews every vendor cell before launch.

examples.description: The products the row's cells cite, comma-separated, as the vendors name them: never a product no cell cites.

cells.description: One cell per column id (validate.mjs checks that every column has one and no other key appears).

value.description: no only where the vendor's documentation says so (a fully managed service is not self-hosted); not_documented where it is silent on the question, shown as "Not documented"; varies only where the docs say it depends (on the judge model, the input size).

vendor.description: The product whose documentation the cell cites, shown next to its value ("Yes · Langfuse"), so a row of several products never credits one vendor's docs to the others. It appears in the row's examples, and every product the examples name is cited by a cell (validate.mjs). Null only while unverified.

text.description: What the vendor documents, in one plain sentence without the vendor's name or the read date (both are shown beside it); empty while unverified.

reviewed.description: The owner reviewed this cell (false until then).
